description: Public lookup of a Crosodo Certified credential (format CC-{ST}-{YY}-{XXXX}, for example CC-VA-26-1042; that ID only illustrates the format and is not a real credential, so looking it up returns Credential not found). Returns public fields only (holder display name, dates, status). Unknown, expired, or revoked credentials return an error. No auth.

certId.description: Credential ID in the format CC-{ST}-{YY}-{XXXX} (e.g. CC-VA-26-1042, format example only, not a real credential)

name: verify_certification
title: Verify Crosodo Certified credential
